subject: POC hands-on lab sprint: follow-the-horizon scheduling
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@craftdata.co>, Onur Yildiz <onur@eta-analytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & hands-on lab sprint: initial schedule options

Hi Sophie / Onur —

Thanks again for agreeing to run a 3-day POC with us. The scope we outlined: prompt review, routing configuration, and two staged load runs (smoke + sustained load). To keep things low friction for your global engineering team, we propose a rotating schedule so each region sees a hands-on window during reasonable local hours. Attached is a short proposal and a calendar file with the options.

High-level windows (all times local equivalents included in the attachment):
- Option A (rotate by day):
  * Day 1: US morning (PST 9:00–12:00) — prompt review, routing checks
  * Day 2: EU afternoon (CEST 14:00–17:00) — deep prompt debugging and small load run
  * Day 3: APAC evening (SGT 18:00–21:00) — large sustained load rehearsal
- Option B (follow-the-horizon):
  * Split each day into two 90-min hands-on blocks separated by 6 hours so on-call engineers can swap in/out.

Questions for you: which option works better for CraftData's on-call rota? Do you prefer we place the prompt-review session before any load tests (recommended), and can you confirm an official list of participants for each day?

Attachments: POC_Sprint_Proposal.pdf, calendar_proposals.ics, prompt_review_checklist.md

If it's helpful I can propose concrete dates next week; Grace will own logistics and Aditya will lead the load test plan from our side.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@craftdata.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Onur Yildiz <onur@eta-analytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 18:41:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on lab sprint: initial schedule options

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear options and the attachments. CraftData likes Option A conceptually because it gives focus to each day, but a couple notes:
- Our APAC team prefers we avoid 18:00 SGT on weekdays if possible — could we shift Day 3 to a 16:00–19:00 SGT window?
- We absolutely want the prompt review before load. Our prompt owners (Tom and a junior eng, Priya) will join Day 1.

I'll confirm the participant roster tomorrow. For dates, Aug 24–26 would work for us if you have capacity.

Best,
Sophie
Head of ML Ops
CraftData Analytics

Hi all — quick operational note from Redwood infra side. For the sustained run on Day 3 we need an uninterrupted 120-minute window for a full KV-cache warmup + steady-state run. If CraftData wants to observe both smoke and sustained in the same day, we can do smoke in the first block and sustained in the second, but that only works if blocks are ~2 hours each.

I attached an update to the calendar_proposals.ics that includes a 2-hr slot for Day 3 and a separate 90-min prompt review block on Day 1. Also flagging that if you need a weekend slot (ET friendly), we can accommodate but will require a short MSA addendum for reserved capacity.

-Kimberly

- Day 3 (sustained load): SGT 16:00–18:00 (requested adjustment accepted)
